bio: William J. Jones, son of Edward F. and Margaret Jones, appears in the 1880 census aged 9/12, born in September (1879) in Pennsylvania, the first of the family born in America ([R4-S1]). He is Anna C. (Jones) McGuire's brother.
sources: [R4-S1] 1880 U.S. census, Plymouth Township, Luzerne Co., Pa., Sup. Dist. 5, ED 144, p.21 (stamped 363A), enumerated 11 Jun 1880 by M. C.
